current_activity: 271st Infantry Division leading elements reach Bernay on the march from Rouen to the Normandy front
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 271. Infanterie-Division page: relieved by parts of the 198th from 30 June, moved to Normandy, unloaded at Rouen and crossed the Seine; "Am 12. Juli 1944 erreichten die vordersten Teile der Division Bernay". Location: Bernay in the Eure, the dataset place Bernay, Eure; the vanguard only, with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the leading elements are at the town, the main body is behind them. Location caveat: the Lexikon page adds "130 km ost-südöstlich Lisieux"; Bernay is about 35 km east-southeast of Lisieux, so the distance in the source is wrong and only the town name is used. Location support: moderate: one source family.

current_activity: 271st Infantry Division front elements begin to relieve the 10th SS Panzer Division on the front southwest of Caen
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 271. Infanterie-Division page: "Ab dem 17. Juli 1944 lösten die vordersten Teile die 10. SS-Panzer-Division an der Normandiefront südwestlich von Caen ab"; by 21 July most of the division was in the line, with parts at Urville, Lisieux and Orbec, and by 25 July it held the right sector of the II SS Panzer Corps; Nafziger Collection 944BGAA: the 10th SS Panzer Division "Being relieved by the 271st Infantry Division". Location: the front southwest of Caen; the point is Bretteville-sur-Laize, with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the page names only the direction from Caen. Location support: moderate: one source family. Relationship: the Lexikon table has the division under the II SS Panzer Corps in July; the row has no parent because the parent decision for the II SS Panzer Corps and its divisions is an open point. Later: open point: whether the 10th SS Panzer Division was under the II SS Panzer Corps for the whole of July; this source only says that it was being relieved.
